summary: Version 1 of the TikZ figure compiles and passes topology and label checks. It reproduces quadrilateral ABCD with top side A–D, bottom side B–C, left side A–B, right side D–C, and both diagonals A–C and B–D, with labels A, B, C, D at the corners. The Critic scored it 0.93 with checklist score 1.0, no must-repair issues, and no missing or extra labels.
